newsitem.title: ESTONIA: TALLINNA KULMHOONE PLANS A SHARE ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: TALLINNA KULMHOONE PLANS A SHARE ISSUE.

text.p: Estonian ice cream maker Tallinna Kulmhoone hopes to launch a new share issue, Aripaev newspaper said on Thursday.
Tallinna Kulmhoone wants to increase its present 15 million kroons share capital less than two times, board member Margus Puust was quoted as saying.
The company's baord will also propose at its shareholders' meeting, due at the end of May, to pay dividends for 1996.
The company had a turnover under 60 million kroons and profit over five million kroons in 1996. It estimates a 60 million kroons turnover and a profit of 5-6 million kroons this year.
It is trade on the Tallinn bourse's over-the-counter market.
